<h2 class="section-title">Global Cues</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Macro Outlook:</strong> RBI Deputy Governor Poonam Gupta noted that while the bond market has performed well, equities may regain attractiveness as the current rate-cut cycle potentially shifts toward rate hikes.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W7</a></span></li>
